title: Ivo and the Autopsy
author: Astrid Delacroix
blurb: Orsen Iversen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
